summary: Re-running the install now recognises a Pro installation correctly.

fixes.title: Install recognises Pro installations again
fixes.text: On some installations, re-running the install did not see that it is Pro, and a new Pro install waited until night for its licence. Both now work at once.

fixes.title: Install guide matches today's names
fixes.text: The install guide no longer lists old job names, and explains how an older installation moves to the current ones.
